atoms.text: The numbers 11 to 19 can be made from <t-blue>one group of ten</t-blue> and <t-yellow>a few ones</t-yellow>.
atoms.sound: The numbers 11 to 19 can be made from one group of ten and a few ones.

example.a: <t-blue>One group of ten</t-blue> and <t-yellow>four more</t-yellow> makes 14.
example.sound: One group of ten and four more makes 14.

atoms.text: A single dot is called a <t-yellow>one</t-yellow>.
atoms.sound: A single dot is called a One.

atoms.text: A group of ten ones is called a <t-blue>ten</t-blue>.
atoms.sound: A group of ten ones is called a ten.

atoms.text: The number fourteen is made from one <t-blue>ten</t-blue> and four <t-yellow>ones</t-yellow>.
atoms.sound: The number fourteen is made from one ten and four ones.

instruction.text: Colour in a ten in blue and some ones in orange to make the number 11.

hint.text: You can change the colour by selecting the other pen.
